Accepted value

Numbers, text, TRUE/FALSE, or formulas with + − × ÷ and cell references. Start literal text with an apostrophe. Double-click a cell, tap the selected cell, or press F2 to edit in place. Enter saves. Escape cancels.

Restore a snapshot

Download the accepted workbook before replacing it. Restore keeps its identity. An imported clone replaces the active workbook with a new identity.
